I am currently a full-time research professional. I have graduated from [WashU Olin Business School](https://olin.wustl.edu) and [Central University of Finance and Economics](https://www.cufe.edu.cn), specializing in Analytics and Economic Disciplines. My academic interest is in empirical corporate finance and labor economics.

This website hosts my brief introduction of experiences in [`vitae`](cv.qmd) section. You can also explore my [`repositories`](repo/index.qmd) with concise notes/cheatsheets, projects, and coding samples.
